item.title: LLMs Can't Save Bad UX
item.description: If the product flow is weak, adding an LLM usually just adds latency, opacity, and a fancier way to disappoint users.

item.title: AI Features Your Users Actually Want (Hint: Not Another Chatbot)
item.description: The AI features users keep rewarding in real products tend to be the ones that remove work instead of asking for another chat prompt.
